image_description: A close-up shot of two signs mounted on a textured, off-white stucco wall. The top sign is a square regulatory sign with rounded corners, featuring a red prohibition circle over a black anchor symbol. The bottom sign is a rectangular blue tile mosaic street sign with white arrows pointing left and right, containing the text 'Santa Catalina Ancha' in a serif font.
